'''2018 US Nationals Day 2 Chris Gogolen DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Gogolen]] at [[2018 U.S. National Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Chris Gogolen]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 U.S. National Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open EOps Gogolen DS 2018 Nats 2.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-us-nationals/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210127141216/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-us-nationals/ Internet Archive]
